title: QC Pipeline Parameters
description: Parameter schema for the QC pipeline

input_csv.description: Path to a CSV file with at least sample column and path to gff3 and to protein file are optional

ensembl_genes_repo.description: Path to a local ensembl-genes checkout

data_file_path.description: Optional explicit path to InterProScan data library

database.description: Optional database to run InterProScan on (default: Pfam)

tracedir.description: Directory for Nextflow execution reports and trace files
